address.description: Elliptec bus address.  Each device on the same ``port`` MUST have a unique address.

homeOnInit.description: If true, home this rotator at startup (uses the bus lock; safe to set on multiple devices).

port.description: Serial port (e.g. ``"COM20"`` on Windows, ``"/dev/ttyUSB0"`` on Linux).

scale.description: ``pylablib`` scale parameter.  Leave at ``"stage"`` unless you're driving a non-standard device.
